about_the_game:
Master Hanzi HSK1 is a learning game that allows you to learn the official 150 vocabulary words of the Chinese HSK Level 1 in a playful way.
The vocabulary is not taught in isolation, but explained in the appropriate context. After completing all the tasks in the learning game, you will be ready to take the official HSK1 test at a university.

Through Comprehensible Input, the game ensures that you understand each character based on its context. In addition to comprehensible input in the right context, the game offers:

  • A system for shadowing native speakers.

  • A flashcard system for practicing reading, writing, listening to tones, and pronunciation.

  • Support for pronunciation of characters in English.

  • The option to learn both simplified and traditional characters as well as Pinyin.

  • An unbeatable price offer.
